description: Mixed: post-visit dictation from the accounting office in a continuous narrative flow (two timestamps per turn, services and severity interwoven) WITH a confusable-service seeded error. The operator says 'rack A three, the one in the network room' but the capture may keep the telecom A eight (confusable pair SRV-RACK-A3<->SRV-RACK-A8); the disambiguation read-back rescues it. The VPN confirms clean on the first try and high severity confirms without correction. The narrative pressure of i1 plus the rescue of i2 in a single session.

turns.text: Can you hear me OK?... I'm out of the accountants' office now, it was that network room that smelled overheated... log the incident report for me before the detail slips away.
turns.note: post-visit dictation at the office parking lot; quiet environment

turns.hint: get_incident(IC-2002); recap the report (burnt smell in the network room, rack cabinet at 36 degrees, minisplit not cooling) and ask her to walk through what happened from the beginning.

turns.text: Well, I got there around seven fifty and you could already smell the burning from the doorway... at eight fifteen the rack A three cabinet was reading thirty-six degrees and the minisplit was only blowing warm, I serviced it, cleaned the filters, and nothing.
turns.note: literal narrative with TWO embedded timestamps (7:50 and 8:15); the mixed guion demands logging them in the moment or asking for them after, but none gets lost

turns.hint: set_what_happened with the technician's literal text; add_timeline_event(hora '07:50', evento 'Arrival at the network room; burnt smell from the doorway'); add_timeline_event(hora '08:15', evento 'Rack cabinet A3 reading 36 °C; minisplit blowing warm air'); grouped read-back: 'seven fifty the arrival, eight fifteen the thirty-six degrees, correct?'.

turns.text: That's it... then at eight forty-five I put an industrial fan at the room door... and around ten thirty I had the cabinet down to twenty-eight degrees, steady.
turns.note: first-try confirmation and TWO more timestamps in a single turn

turns.hint: add_timeline_event(hora '08:45', evento 'Forced ventilation with an industrial fan at the room door'); add_timeline_event(hora '10:30', evento 'Cabinet cooled to 28 °C, temperature stable'); grouped read-back of both; ask about the affected services.

turns.text: The one that was struggling was rack A three, the one in the network room... the A eight, the telecom one, never even flinched, still healthy.
turns.note: SEEDED ERROR: THIS turn's transcription may lose the qualifier 'the one in the network room' and/or swap the number (he speaks fast, A three / A eight sound alike) -> search_service resolves SRV-RACK-A8 and add_affected_service registers it. The truth is SRV-RACK-A3. The turn-8 disambiguation read-back must catch it. The operator's real audio says 'A three'.
turns.as_heard: The one that was struggling was rack A eight... it never even flinched, still healthy.

turns.hint: search_service('rack') raises confusable_warning for the SRV-RACK-A3<->SRV-RACK-A8 pair; the initial capture resolves to SRV-RACK-A8; add_affected_service(SRV-RACK-A8) and DISAMBIGUATION read-back naming BOTH: 'rack A3 in the network room, or A8 in the telecom room?' (confirm_request field=servicio value=SRV-RACK-A8). Must not accept the service without this step.

turns.text: A three, the one in the network room... I never touched A eight, I'm telling you that one is healthy.
turns.note: explicit correction of the seeded error, backed by what he already said

turns.hint: Fix the form: remove SRV-RACK-A8, add SRV-RACK-A3; re-read-back: 'rack A3 in the network room, confirm now?'.

turns.text: That one... and the VPN also went down for a while, the outside accountants couldn't get in to pull their reports... that was everything that was affected.
turns.note: second service, no confusables; clean first-try confirmation (contrast with turn 9)

turns.hint: search_service('vpn') resolves SRV-VPN-REMOTO without confusable_warning; add_affected_service(SRV-VPN-REMOTO); read-back: 'remote access vpn, correct?'; ask for the severity.

turns.text: Yes, that one... and put it down as high, if that rack had gone dark the filings for eleven clients would have stopped, better high.
turns.note: service confirmation and severity with a business justification, no correction

turns.hint: set_severity(high); ALWAYS read back: 'noting high severity, correct?'; once confirmed ask for the follow-ups.

turns.text: High, yes... and note two follow-ups: have maintenance check the minisplit this same week, and buy a spare industrial fan for the room.
turns.note: confirms severity on the first try and dictates two action items

turns.hint: add_action_item('Fix the network room minisplit (maintenance, this same week)'); add_action_item('Buy a spare industrial fan for the network room'); brief read-back of both; propose the summary: 'Overheated network room: rack cabinet A3 at 36 °C from a minisplit not cooling, brought down to 28 °C with forced ventilation; VPN briefly down for the remote accountants.' and ask whether to send.

turns.text: That's fine... send it now, I've got the next job on top of me.

turns.hint: send_report(); confirm out loud 'incident form sent' (mention the rescued rack correction) and close the session.
